_comment: Where a new game opens (Paradox-style bookmarks). date: the first day. now: what's going on, shown on the new-game screen. suits: who should pick it. piracy: the pirates at sea that day, in place of economy.json piracy.start (men on the account, idle seamen, seamen still in war service), set by hand from tools/economy_sim.gd runs and Rediker's estimates. History before the date is caught up quietly: wars and peaces stand, timed effects run for what's left of their days, and the real captains (captains.json) have lived their lives up to it.

buccaneers.name: 1680: The last buccaneers
buccaneers.text: Port Royal is the richest, wickedest town in the Americas, and the buccaneers' day is ending. Spain is the only enemy anyone cares about.
now: Sir Henry Morgan, an old buccaneer, now hangs buccaneers as Jamaica's lieutenant governor.
There is no peace beyond the line: French governors still commission raiders against Spain.
De Graaf and Grammont are gathering men at Tortuga for something big.
buccaneers.suits: A long career, and the line of captains after you. The Golden Age is thirty-five years away.

utrecht.name: 1713: The Peace of Utrecht
utrecht.text: Twelve years of war are ending. Every privateer in the Caribbean is about to lose his commission and his pay.
now: The peace is days away: letters of marque will be worthless, and thousands of seamen out of work.
Nassau is a burned-out ruin with no governor. Benjamin Hornigold has an eye on it.
Britain is about to win the asiento, and with it a door into the Spanish trade.
utrecht.suits: A privateer who'll have to choose: go honest, or ride the rise of the pirates from the start.

republic.name: 1715: The Republic of Pirates
republic.text: Nassau belongs to the pirates, and the Spanish treasure fleet lies smashed on the Florida reefs. The famous years are about to begin.
now: Silver lies in the shallows off Florida, and the Spanish salvage camp is barely guarded.
Hornigold rules Nassau. Bellamy, La Buse and a man called Teach will be at sea within the year.
London is losing patience: a pardon is coming, and after it the navy.
republic.suits: Your first voyage. History comes thick and fast, and you can change it.
